subject: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts:
Hi,
In order to avoid the creation of an SAF file as input for fatureCounts that I dont need afterwards, I changed the featureCounts call to something like the following:

featureCounts ... \
-a <(awk 'BEGIN {{ OFS = "\\t" }} {{print $4,$1,$2,$3,"+"}}' bed_file) \
...

so I am using process substitution.However, this seems to make featureCounts hang:

 Annotation : /dev/fd/63 (SAF)      
...                     

|| Load annotation file /dev/fd/63 ...         


Am I doing something wrong, or why isn't this working properly?

Thanks,
Christian

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Re: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts:
Is it because of this (a description of the limitations of named pipes used for input): This file can be opened and read, but not written, not seeked.

The last part seems relevant here, as I presume featureCounts tries to seek the file for the annotation features. If that is true, it might be a good idea to throw an error if a pipe is used as input via checking the file properties.

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts:
Yes, it was because of the non-seekable file. FeatureCounts scans the annotations twice, and rewinds the file handler in between. If the file handler cannot be rewinded, featureCounts will wait forever in the second scan.

It is better not to scan it twice. We can change the program to remove the first scan.

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Re: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts: Thanks for the reply! Of course the best would be to make it work also for pipes as input. If that is not possible, at least preventing it from hanging would be good. What are your thoughts on this?

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts: Yes we will do more checking in the code and prevent it from hanging. We will also try to output a message when any issues with the annotation are found.

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Anonymous named pipe as input for the annotation makes featureCounts hang
parts:
I have removed the first scan. The annotation (gzipped or in plain txt) can be fed into featureCounts through a pipe. 

This feature will be included in the next release.

BTW, the other functions in Subread will also accept annotations from pipes in the next release. However, the other files (inc, fastq files, fasta files and SAM or BAM files as input) have to be standard files.
